entities.summary: Gina Elena Zefora Lombroso was an Italian physician, writer, psychiatrist, and criminologist, best remembered for her uncredited writings on the subjects of criminology and psychiatry co-authored with her father, anthropologist Cesare Lombroso, and her individual writings on the female condition and industrialisation. She was the wife of Italian historian and writer Guglielmo Ferrero.
